name: xianxia-visual-director
title_zh: 把仙侠场景画成有呼吸感的电影级东方奇观
tagline_zh: 画仙侠总像贴图堆砌？这套 canon 固定五层空间、40–60% 留白呼吸感，让建筑悬空无栏杆、仙人衣袂自带风。
tagline_en: Tired of flat xianxia art? Fixed 5-layer space, 40–60% breathing air, railing-free floating architecture, robes.
desc_en: Generate, derive, optimize, and diagnose structured AI image prompts for luminous cinematic Eastern xianxia environments under one inherited master canon with measurable divine scale, fixed five-layer space, 40–60% content-bearing breathing air, monumental Eastern architecture, railing-free edges, and coherent immortals and costume. Cover one-location scenic landmarks, immense inhabited celestial
why_zh: 不是随机抽风格，而是继承单一主 canon：可量化的神域尺度、固定空间层次、留白比例硬约束。
why_en: Not random style roulette—one inherited canon with measurable divine scale, fixed depth layers, and enforced breathing-air.
limit_zh: 只覆盖东方仙侠环境与人物服饰的静态场景；不含动作、战斗、多镜头叙事。prompt 输出为结构化文本，不生成图像。
limit_en: Static xianxia environments & costumes only—no action, combat, or multi-shot narrative. Outputs structured prompt text, not images; bring your own.
title_en: Turn xianxia scenes into breathing cinematic Eastern wonders
